# `company.shipment_recognitions`

Immutable: cost moved between Shipped Not Invoiced and cost of goods sold for one shipment line, at its date, as the derived balance requires.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this recognition. |
| `shipment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | shipments.id | Shipment whose line it is. |
| `shipment_line_identity` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_recognitions_line | — | Stable identity of the shipment line. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | transactions.id | Journal entry carrying it (inventory_documents kind shipment_cost). |
| `effective_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_recognitions_line | — | Date it is recognised, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Signed cost moved from Shipped Not Invoiced to cost of goods sold. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency of the amount. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this shipment recognition was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this shipment recognition. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this shipment recognition. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this shipment recognition. |
